title: RegressionGP Predict
text: Predict responses using Gaussian process (GP) regression model, 1 input, 3 outputs, direct feedthrough, {Output standard deviation data type} sets Data type of ysd output Inherit:; {Select trained machine learning model} sets the gaussian process regression, {Add output port for estimated standard deviation} sets the optional output port for standard, {Add output port for prediction intervals} sets the optional output port for prediction, {Alpha} sets the significance level, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the prevention of fixed-point tools from overriding data, {Output data type} sets the data type of yfit output Inherit, {Output data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of yfit output for range checking, {Output data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of yfit output for range checking, {Output standard deviation data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of ysd output for range checking, {Output standard deviation data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of ysd output for range checking, {Output prediction intervals data type} sets the data type of yint output Inherit, {Output prediction intervals data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of yint output for range checking, {Output prediction intervals data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of yint output for range checking, {Kernel data type} sets the data type of kernel function Inherit, {Kernel data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of kernel function, {Kernel data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of kernel function, {Distance data type} sets the data type of method for computing kernel distance, {Distance data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of kernel distance, {Distance data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of kernel distance, {Basis data type} sets the data type of basis function Inherit, {Basis data type Minimum} sets the minimum value of basis function and {Basis data type Maximum} sets the maximum value of basis function. Values come from the instance.
